title: Tensor compatibility of ordinary pullback composition
statement: Let X,Y,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], k:Z→Y and l:Y→X, and let M,N be O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Use the ordinary adjoint-defined Scheme.Modules.pullback and its canonical pullbackComp. Use the fixed strong monoidal instance [lem-pc-scheme-pullback-monoidal-existing], with tensorator μ. Then μ_k(l*M,l*N) followed by k*(μ_l(M,N)) and pullbackComp(k,l) at M tensor N equals the tensor of pullbackComp(k,l) at M and N followed by μ_(k followed by l)(M,N). The exact equality is lean.statement; no pairing, unit, flatness or finite-generation hypothesis is present.

source.place: Definition 6.26.1(2), tensor formula; Tag 0096, adjunction normalizing the composition comparison. Expanded tensor/unit-composition argument of lem-sc-picard-pairing-composition.

proof.text: The adjunction-normalized presheaf composition comparison sends r tensor (s tensor m) to r*k-sharp(s) tensor m. For two pure iterated tensors, the two routes have coefficients r*r-prime*k-sharp(s*s-prime) and (r*k-sharp(s))*(r-prime*k-sharp(s-prime)); the ring-map law and commutativity equate them. Representatives in the inverse-image colimits restrict to a common neighbourhood, and the formula respects restrictions and balancing. Tensor and colimit universal properties extend the equality to presheaf maps; after sheafification, locally represented finite sums determine the sheaf maps. The fixed monoidal localization and sheafificationCompPullback identify the tensorators. The descended composition sends 1 tensor (1 tensor m) to 1 tensor m, hence has the composite adjunction unit; injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection identifies it with the fixed pullbackComp. Empty schemes, zero modules, zero rings and identity arrows obey the same laws.

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackComp_tensor
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Z ⟶ Y) (l : Y ⟶ X) (M N : X.Modules) :
    (Functor.Monoidal.μIso (pullback k) ((pullback l).obj M)
      ((pullback l).obj N)).hom ≫
      (pullback k).map (Functor.Monoidal.μIso (pullback l) M N).hom ≫
        (pullbackComp k l).hom.app (M ⊗ N) =
    ((pullbackComp k l).hom.app M ⊗ₘ (pullbackComp k l).hom.app N) ≫
      (Functor.Monoidal.μIso (pullback (k ≫ l)) M N).hom
